verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents assigning a public IP to a machine to make it reachable over the internet, and offers a private network as a feature at machine creation. Shared drives are accessible across machines in a private network, and a community user reports hosting Plex servers on Paperspace machines. Missing for 10: explicit port/firewall configuration docs, detailed private-networking docs on instance-to-instance connectivity (subnets, cross-region behavior), and independent hands-on corroboration of private networking.
